text:
The Network Data Management view is divided into four sections:
- Tools for data management.
- User administration tasks.
- Table for data editing.
- [View options](#kw:64-view-options:none).
![Image p269](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp269-img4.png)
To navigate through the tables, click on the table name at the top right corner.
![Image p269](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp269-img2.png)
To select a record, click on a record with the left mouse button. Selected records are colored in blue:
![Image p269](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp269-img3.png)

The Data management tools are found at the top of the screen:
![Image p270](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp270-img1.png)

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp270-img9.png) 
Load data from the previously configured server location and open the Table view. Here, several functions can be performed, e.g., sorting or filtering data.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp270-img10.png) 
Go one step back and show previous data.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp270-img11.png)
Sieve the data in the currently opened table for one or more filter terms.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp270-img12.png) 
View and edit all tables from one site simultaneously in one window.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp270-img13.png) 
View the list of attachments associated with a given record. To do so, select a record of choice, then click on the View attachments button and a dialog will open with the respective attachments listed. To view an attachment in a separate browser tab simply click on the attachment of choice

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp270-img14.png) 
Synchronize the previously selected server database with changes performed in the Table view.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp271-img9.png) 
Select/unselect all currently shown database records.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp271-img10.png) 
Shows all currently selected database records or all the records.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp271-img11.png) 
Move an object from one site to another. To do so, select an object and click on the Move Record button. Then select the site you want to move the object to and click the move button again. Note that attachments are not moved.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp271-img12.png) 
Duplicate a database record from the Table view. Select the record to be duplicated. Then click the Copy Record button and the duplicated record appears in pink color in the Table view as a new record. Note that if the selected record to be duplicated has child objects, Copy Record will duplicate the entire record incl. child objects. Attachments are not duplicated.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp271-img13.png) 
Add a new record to the Table view. Note that the newly added record will appear in orange writing.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp271-img14.png) 
Call CE API tool. Note: The administrator has to configure the tool.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp272-img7.png) 
Export selected items.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp272-img8.png) 
Remove a selected record from the current view. Note that removed records will be hidden from the user. Only administrators can delete a removed record from the database permanently (or restore it).

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp272-img9.png) 
Removes selected objects.
![Image p272](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp272-img4.png)

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp272-img10.png) Opens the menu for exploring and importing data:
![Image p272](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp272-img6.png)
See section 6 for details.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp273-img1.png) 
Opens the menu for administrator functions:
![Image p273](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp273-img2.png)
Please view Administration Guide for details.

![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp273-img3.png)
![Image p273](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp273-img4.png)
Help - Displays the User Guide for quick help.
Logout – Logoff the user from CE Inventory3D

The table comprises all network data. The data can be managed with the Data Management tools (see
above).
Click on one of the buttons to choose a view of the data table aligned with the map (section 3.2).
